scope: Identity layer over the already admitted Chamber of Deputies lists: list kind, proposers, coalition membership and reviewed continuity. No election result is re-imported or changed.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner replies: 'Authorise one retrieval' of the named volby.gov.cz register files, and 'Yes, per file': a catalogue entry recording no copyright work, no protected database and no personal data closes that file's reuse gates. Files without such an entry stay unused.

reuse_right.basis: Per-file catalogue entries in evidence.json. The 2025 list register has no entry and is unused.

normalized_republication.basis: Same per-file metadata. Interior Ministry register: no reuse terms located, so it is cited and registration identifiers are not reproduced.

raw_redistribution.basis: List registers and composition tables are archived in full, code lists as excerpts with the full file's checksum. The 2017 candidate register psrk.xml is neither extracted nor committed.

acquisition_route.basis: One sequential retrieval of 11 named files, 5 seconds apart, identifying User-Agent. volby.gov.cz stays automation-not-allowed otherwise. The Interior Ministry pages were read manually.

source_files_complete.basis: Every admitted list resolves to official proposers; 2017 and 2021 also to a register type and seats. Missing for 2025 only: VSTRANA, POCSTRVKO and POCMANDCR.

national_definition_complete.basis: Unchanged: results stay as admitted; shares use valid list votes in all three elections.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: A list with one proposer is a party_list and with several a coalition; 53 seat counts cross-check between register and DataStat. Coalition votes and seats are never divided.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Unchanged, except that notes no longer say list kinds are unknown. No threshold outcome is computed per list.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: 2017 uses the register state of 21 October 2017, matching the original-results vintage that does not reflect Vol 58/2017-173. 2021 stays final, with Vol 102/2021 recorded as leaving elected deputies unchanged.

continuity_rule: same_party needs the same ČSÚ proposer code and an Interior Ministry review showing one registration active since before the first election. Names never link. Any other same-code pair stays explicitly unresolved.
limits: No official crosswalk between Interior Ministry records and NSTRANA was located; the current register name and abbreviation are compared with the ČSÚ code list.
No official statement of NSTRANA stability was located, only for VSTRANA; in the 2017 and 2021 registers each single-party list has VSTRANA equal to NSTRANA.
The register history view prints the current name on every dated period, so past names cannot be read from it.
